article.story: NEWARK, N.J. -- — Ognjen Stankovic had 22 points in Manhattan’s 81-70 win against NJIT on Wednesday. Stankovic added 14 rebounds and six assists for the Jaspers (2-5). Ben Pearce scored 19 points and Josiah Sabino finished with 15 points. David Bolden led the Highlanders (1-8) in scoring, finishing with 19 points, seven assists, three steals and four blocks. NJIT also got 15 points from Mario Tatum Jr. Quentin Duncan also had 11 points. The loss is the sixth straight for the Highlanders. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
